check: confirm the corrected never-run count by checking when the five unrenamed classes were added
why: Correcting the count from 23 to 21 rested on showing that two of WallArchPreparation's cases were renames. That leaves the other five classes attributed with 20 never-run tests, and the same flaw could apply to them - a class could have existed under a different name when the 10-03 run happened.
method: Asked git for the commit that added each class file, which answers whether the class could have run on 10-03 at all.
verdict: Every one postdates the 10-03 run, three by two days and two by four days. None existed in any form when that run happened, so for these 20 tests absence genuinely means never run rather than renamed.
whyThisCompletesTheCorrection: The 21 decomposes into 1 genuinely new case in a pre-existing class and 20 cases in classes that did not exist. Both halves are now established by history rather than by comparing two name lists.
